project.description: Configures Open Access/Discover and Explore Without Login independently. Anonymous access is enabled in PSAMA and the gateway when either product feature is enabled.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ENABLE_OPEN_ACCESS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Enable Discover using the dedicated open HPDS backend.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ENABLE_EXPLORE_WITHOUT_LOGIN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Allow anonymous users to use Explorer against the authenticated HPDS backend.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CONFIRM_AUTH_HPDS_PUBLIC
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: I understand that Explore Without Login makes authenticated HPDS data publicly accessible.
